name: DIYMall X0040MB5LN 8-bit WS2812B Ring
description: 8-pixel WS2812B/NeoPixel ring, 5V, one data line in and one out so rings chain. Two of them make a pair of eyes on a single GPIO.

meta.notes: Chain two rings on one data line and address them as a single 16-pixel strip: left eye pixels 0-7, right eye 8-15 (that is ringSplit). Needs a common ground with the Pi and 5V that can carry the whole chain at full white - 16 pixels is about 1A, which is more than a Pi header pin should source, so power the rings from the supply rail, not from the board. Driven by python_wrappers/led_ring_daemon.py: PWM+DMA via rpi_ws281x on a Pi 4 (root, GPIO18 = PWM0, blacklist snd_bcm2835), RP1 PIO on a Pi 5 (no root, any data GPIO).
